Name: Maid Outfit (Fashion Sense - SMAPI)
Author: pady32guan
Description:
[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[size=2]  Install SMAPI and Fashion sense[/size]
  Select the file you desire from main and optional files:
    Maid dress & hairstyle only, or with optional skin tone. download only one file.
  Unzip and move Maid Dress and LWA Skintone (if included) into the mods folder in the game directory
  launch the game!
[size=4][b]Usage:
[/b][/size]  Purchase the Hand mirror from Pierre and use it to modify your outfit.
  Change your skin tone to 14 in the Wizard's basement or character creation menu to access the custom skin tone shown in the images
[b][size=3]KNOWN ISSUE:[/size][/b]
  Do not use slingshot while equipting the sleeves, it may cause a crash
Enjoy!
